entries.title: Compiler below package minimum
entries.root_cause: The workflow selects Rust 1.77.2 while the harvest crate requires Rust 1.81. Update the workflow toolchain to a supported version.

entries.title: Database role password rejected
entries.root_cause: The integration job supplies a password for the lichen_runner PostgreSQL role that does not match the password configured on the database service. Align the job and service credentials.
